title: Akiyama Mizuki — An Awaited Notification〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I came just in case, but I guess she isn't here...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something may've happened to her phone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're able to see what's going on over in your world by using the functionality of your phones.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, does this mean her phone's broken?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
B-But, I mean... Now?
That seems like way too big a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really hope that her phone just happened to run out of battery or something...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she also said that she'd let us know if she couldn't make it...)

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting.
Table for one...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: One of your friends came and went just a second ago... Are you by yourself today?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me...
I always see the four of you together, so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, now's not the time for that...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Excuse me, but was this person wearing a Miya Girls uniform?! She usually has her hair in a ponytail!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
I just missed her! We'll be back again soon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Then...
She probably wants to see us really badly!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which means I should check that place too...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Mafuyu and I went rollerblading...
And what else...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't see her in the strike zone corner...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I didn't realize how hard Mafuyu not being able to use her phone would make this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We still don't know what actually happened to her phone...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But what if she was about to have it taken away... It'd be like her computer all over again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which means she won't be able to use Nightcord... Or go to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In other words, she'd lose all the safe spaces where she can just be herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She won't be able to escape anywhere...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Miku and KAITO were able to reach Mafuyu's phone...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is she okay?! How's she feeling...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Calm down...
I'll tell you what KAITO told me.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Fortunately, she managed to hang onto it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The silver lining in a way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, is it true...?
She's really gonna tell her mom how she feels...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is she gonna be okay...?
I mean, she's been so afraid of telling her mom how she really feels...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <She's apparently made her decision, so all we can do now is believe that she will...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For now, I should tell Kanade and Ena that... What?! My battery only has 20% left?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<There's nothing else you can do here.
Why don't you go home for the time being...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luka and the others are gonna tell Kanade and Ena what's going on, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I agree that there's nothing for me to do here. And me becoming unreachable would only make things worse...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, I'll head home and wait to hear back from Miku and KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me know, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hate not being able to help you right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But for now, I should head home and charge my phone...
